name: Webhook-Tester
description: Catch and inspect webhooks and HTTP requests in real time

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Saved sessions and the requests they caught.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Webhook Tester web page and webhook URLs, published on host as 6897

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: STORAGE_DRIVER
variables.description: fs keeps sessions and requests in the data folder, so they survive restarts. memory forgets them on restart.

variables.name: FS_STORAGE_DIR
variables.description: Where fs storage keeps its files. Leave it as /data.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: console for readable logs, json for log tools.
